trends.name: China Real Estate Collapse Accelerates
trends.summary: New home prices in 70 Chinese cities fell 3.2% YoY in February—the steepest annual drop in 8 months. Home prices have now fallen in 44 of the last 47 months, signaling a structural crisis in China's largest asset class and economy. This deepens recession risks for global growth and commodity demand.

trends.name: Middle East Oil Supply Disruption & Strategic Reserves
trends.summary: Iran reports attacks on key oil/gas fields while China nears drawdowns of 1M barrels/day from commercial stockpiles over 4-6 weeks. Trump's Jones Act waiver signals oil market stress. Geopolitical tension in Strait of Hormuz and Middle East assassinations are tightening supply and pushing crude prices higher.

trends.name: Nvidia Valuation & AI Competition Concerns
trends.summary: While Nvidia's $1 trillion sales forecast is achievable, competition and shifting market dynamics are keeping institutional investors sidelined. Historical precedent suggests massive rallies in semiconductor leaders often end badly, raising questions about whether Nvidia has become overextended despite solid fundamentals.

trends.name: Eurozone Inflation Stabilizes Below Expectations
trends.summary: Eurozone CPI came in at 1.9% YoY (matching estimates) with core inflation at 2.4%, but month-over-month CPI printed 0.6% vs. 0.7% expected. Softer momentum data may influence ECB policy decisions and suggest disinflation is progressing, potentially supporting risk assets if recession fears ease.

trends.name: Russia-Europe Energy Decoupling & Gas Market Strain
trends.summary: Kremlin signals potential permanent exit from European gas market while indicating no dialogue signals from Europe. European gas prices remain elevated despite recent slips as supply strains persist. Long-term decoupling reshapes energy markets and adds structural inflation risks for Europe.

trends.name: Fed Rate Cut Expectations Pushed Back
trends.summary: Hot inflation reports are delaying market expectations for the next Federal Reserve rate cut, signaling the hiking cycle may remain in effect longer than previously anticipated. This keeps pressure on growth stocks and extends duration risk for bond portfolios.

trends.name: Memory Chip Prices Surge, Micron Outperforms
trends.summary: Micron's stock surged 62% as memory chip prices spike heading into earnings, significantly outperforming broader tech peers. Supply-demand tightness in DRAM/NAND markets is creating a rare positive catalyst for semiconductor investors and signaling pricing power in the sector.

trends.name: Retail & Consumer Discretionary Resilience Signals
trends.summary: Macy's proved skeptics wrong with growing sales and stock surge despite expecting sales declines ahead, while Disney appoints new CEO D'Amaro. Green Dot receives bull case upgrade. Mixed signals suggest selective consumer strength and management transitions reshaping retail narrative.

trends.name: GLP-1 Drugs Reshape Obesity & Healthcare Market
trends.summary: Millions adopting GLP-1s are forcing a fundamental rethinking of obesity definitions and healthcare delivery models. This trend supports pharma/biotech valuations but pressures diet and weight-loss adjacent sectors, creating major portfolio rotation opportunities.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk: Iran-Israel Escalation & Ukraine Expansion
trends.summary: Israel killed Iran's intelligence minister in a third assassination in 48 hours, while Zelensky confirms 200 Ukrainian drone operatives are in the Middle East assisting against Iran. Geopolitical escalation risks widening regional conflict with oil/gas market implications and FX volatility.

trends.name: Defense & Aerospace Sector Growth Support
trends.summary: Saab receives upgrade citing revitalized war environment extending growth prospects. Persistent geopolitical tensions and defense spending increases are providing structural tailwinds to aerospace and defense contractors, attracting institutional capital flows.

trends.name: US Policy Uncertainty: Tariffs, Immigration, Tax Overhaul
trends.summary: Senate confirmation hearings for DHS, intelligence, and national security roles reveal deep rifts (Mullin-Paul tensions). Trump's Greenland/Panama rhetoric concerns EU allies. Democrats propose millionaire surtax to fund tax cuts. Policy unpredictability is weighing on market sentiment and investment decisions.
